s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic multisystem disease with autoimmune features, characterized by skin, joint, and lung involvement, with a prolonged course and significant weight loss
salient_findings: Symmetric swelling of metacarpophalangeal and interphalangeal joints with ulcers
Dyspigmentation and atrophy of distal fingers
Bibasilar rales and restrictive lung disease
Elevated ferritin and lymphocytopenia
Positive anti-SSA (Ro) and anticardiolipin antibodies
key_facts: 7-month history of fatigue, exertional dyspnea, arthralgias, and hand swelling
50-pound weight loss
Previous hospitalization for hypoxia
Prior treatment with prednisone
Normal capillaroscopy
Ulcerated lichenoid papules on palmar IP creases
Oxford Scale muscle strength 5 of 5 throughout
Elevated ferritin (1543 ng/mL)
Depressed creatine kinase (32 U/L)
Lymphocytopenia with CD3: 328 μL, CD4: 233 μL, CD8: 85 μL
Positive anti-SSA (Ro) and anticardiolipin antibodies
Normal prothrombin time, partial thromboplastin time, and tissue thromboplastin
Chest CT showed hilar lymphadenopathy, interstitial thickening, and perilymphatic ground glass opacities
Pulmonary function tests showed restrictive disease with decreased diffusing capacity (33% predicted)

shortlist.label: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: Positive anti-SSA (Ro) and anticardiolipin antibodies, lymphocytopenia, and multisystem involvement

shortlist.label: Sjögren's Syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Positive anti-SSA (Ro) antibodies and symptoms of dryness

shortlist.label: Antiphospholipid Syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Positive anticardiolipin antibodies and history of thrombosis

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Skin ulcerations, hair loss, and muscle weakness

shortlist.label: Mixed Connective Tissue Disease
shortlist.why_kept: Overlapping features of lupus, rheumatoid arthritis, and scleroderma

shortlist.label: Scleroderma
shortlist.why_kept: Skin thickening and fibrosis, although capillaroscopy was normal

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Hilar lymphadenopathy and interstitial lung disease

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of hilar lymphadenopathy, interstitial lung disease, and skin lesions, along with elevated ferritin and lymphocytopenia, is most consistent with sarcoidosis. The absence of specific antibodies for other autoimmune diseases and the presence of non-caseating granulomas (suggested by plaquelike lesions on bronchoscopy) further support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
rejected.why: Lack of specific antibodies and typical lupus manifestations

rejected.label: Antiphospholipid Syndrome
rejected.why: Presence of anticardiolipin antibodies is not exclusive to this condition

rejected.label: Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: Normal muscle strength and lack of specific myositis antibodies

rejected.label: Mixed Connective Tissue Disease
rejected.why: Insufficient overlap of different autoimmune diseases

rejected.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis
rejected.why: Lack of typical joint deformities and rheumatoid factor

rejected.label: Scleroderma
rejected.why: Absence of anti-Scl-70 antibodies and sclerodermatous skin changes
